Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; SCHOOL-LINKED BEHAVIORAL HEALTH GRANTS. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for start-up grants to develop certified family peer specialist services within existing children's mental health providers under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.4889, subdivision 1, paragraph (b), clause (18). This is a onetime appropriation. +]

Sec. 3. [+APPROPRIATION; MOBILE CRISIS GRANTS. +]

[+$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for mobile crisis grants under Minnesota Statutes, sections 245.4661, subdivision 9, paragraph (b), clause (15), and 245.4889, subdivision 1, paragraph (b), clause (4). Sec. 4. [+APPROPRIATION; MENTAL HEALTH GRANTS FOR HEALTH CARE PROFESSIONALS. +]

bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to mental health; appropriating money for mental health grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SCHOOL-LINKED BEHAVIORAL HEALTH GRANTS.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for school-linked behavioral health grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.4901. This is a onetime appropriation.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; FAMILY PEER SPECIALIST START-UP GRANTS.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for start-up grants to develop certified family peer specialist services within existing children's mental health providers under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.4889, subdivision 1, paragraph (b), clause (18). This is a onetime appropriation.

Sec. 3. APPROPRIATION; MOBILE CRISIS GRANTS.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for mobile crisis grants under Minnesota Statutes, sections 245.4661, subdivision 9, paragraph (b), clause (15), and 245.4889, subdivision 1, paragraph (b), clause (4). This is a onetime appropriation.

Sec. 4. APPROPRIATION; MENTAL HEALTH GRANTS FOR HEALTH CARE PROFESSIONALS.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for mental health grants for health care professionals under Laws 2022, chapter 99, article 1, section 46, as amended by Laws 2023, chapter 70, article 4, section 94. This is a onetime appropriation.

Sec. 5. APPROPRIATION; CHILDREN'S RESIDENTIAL MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS STABILIZATION GRANTS.

$....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for grants to direct service providers and partnering county human services agencies to provide children's residential mental health crisis stabilization services. This is a onetime appropriation.

A bill for an act relating to mental health; appropriating money for mental health grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; SCHOOL-LINKED BEHAVIORAL HEALTH GRANTS.

$7,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for school-linked behavioral health grants under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.4901. This is a onetime appropriation.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATION; FAMILY PEER SPECIALIST START-UP GRANTS.

$1,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for start-up grants to develop certified family peer specialist services within existing children's mental health providers under Minnesota Statutes, section 245.4889, subdivision 1, paragraph (b), clause (18). This is a onetime appropriation.

Sec. 3. APPROPRIATION; MOBILE CRISIS GRANTS.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of human services for mobile crisis grants under Minnesota Statutes, sections 245.4661, subdivision 9, paragraph (b), clause (15), and 245.4889, subdivision 1, paragraph (b), clause (4). This is a onetime appropriation.

Sec. 4. APPROPRIATION; MENTAL HEALTH GRANTS FOR HEALTH CARE PROFESSIONALS.

$5,000,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of health for mental health grants for health care professionals under Laws 2022, chapter 99, article 1, section 46, as amended by Laws 2023, chapter 70, article 4, section 94. This is a onetime appropriation.

This is a onetime appropriation.
